expected.name: Bill Steyert
expected.description: Bill Steyert was jailed following an anti-nuclear protest at the LaSalle nuclear power plant in Illinois. A contemporary June 1983 report records an April 20 trespass conviction and a thirty-day contempt sentence after the two defendants spoke about the dangers of nuclear power despite the judge's order. An additional fifteen-day trespass sentence followed. Both were released on appeal bond on May 23, 1983.
expected.body: Source: Nuclear Resister 17, June 6, 1983, page 4. The reported thirty- and fifteen-day sentences are not stored as actual time served.
